messages:
Maya (AE): FYI, Acme just dropped a request: add telemetry + evaluation KPIs to the POC and include embeddings + rerank AND low-latency chat in the same scope. Meeting tomorrow 10am to decide if we accept scope change. Thoughts?

Ajay (SE): Short: doable but it's a scope jump. Embeddings+rerank is batchy and storage-heavy; low-latency chat needs a warm KV cache and smaller model profile. Do we want to run both in parallel or split into two phases?

Patrick (Infra Eng): If we keep them on hosted for now, embeddings throughput will spike cost. Quick thumb calc: 5k docs => 5k embedding ops. At our hosted embedding unit rate that's nontrivial. For chat p95 <250ms we need either dedicated capacity or pinned warm nodes + prefix cache. Also BYO-KMS adds ~3 business days of ops work.

Sophia (CS): From the customer side they want clear success criteria before approving extra spend: 1) embedding recall@10 >= 0.85 on their eval set, 2) median chat latency <= 250ms and p95 <= 400ms, 3) rerank lift (precision@5) >= +10%. They also want token/cost telemetry per route in the Redwood Console for the POC.

Ajay (SE): We can propose two options in the reply:
```
- Option A (Fast, higher cost): Dedicated small pool for chat + full embeddings on hosted.
- Option B (Budget-constrained): Sample embeddings (1k docs) + async rerank pipeline (2s SLA) + smaller chat model.
```
Option A gets us the latency; Option B keeps cost predictable but relaxes latency/SLOs.

Maya (AE): Pricing question: what's the incremental committed cost for a small dedicated pool? Can we do a 3-week evaluation with prorated billing so they can see latency numbers? Also they asked whether we can show telemetry in the console during that window.

Patrick (Infra Eng): Ballpark: dedicated small pool (2x A100-ish equivalent) ~ $8k/mo reserved. We can do a 3-week trial with a prorated invoice (~$4k) if Finance signs off. Console telemetry is available for hosted routes immediately; for Dedicated we need to enable metrics export (1-2 days setup). KMS integration: if they want their KMS, add ~1 week and escalate to security.

Sophia (CS): Security side: SAML SSO + SSO SCIM ok. They want SOC2 report and KMS attestation — legal will handle SOC2 disclosure; ops will need to sign the KMS runbook. If they press for on-prem/private, that adds 2-3 weeks of setup.

Ajay (SE): Technical tradeoffs to surface in the reply: 1) accuracy vs cost: sampling the docs reduces embedding cost but affects recall. 2) latency vs throughput: achieving p95 <400ms at scale needs dedicated nodes or aggressive caching. 3) telemetry fidelity: per-route token/cost is available, but correlating to user-level events needs planned instrumentation on their side.

Maya (AE): OK — plan for tomorrow: propose Option A (dedicated trial) + Option B (budget fallback) with clear success criteria (Sophia's three bullets). Action items: Ajay to draft technical note with config snippet and expected latency/cost tradeoffs; Patrick to prepare provisional pricing and timeline for dedicated trial; Sophia to draft success criteria language and security checklist. I'll send the proposed reply to Acme before the 10am.

Ajay (SE): Draft snippet for the config we'll share:
```
routes:
  - name: chat-lowlatency
    model: gpt-neo-small-optimized
    capacity: dedicated
    cache: kv_prefix
    sla: p95<=400ms
  - name: rerank-embeddings
    model: embed-512
    capacity: hosted
    batch: async
    sample_size: 1000  # optional fallback to reduce cost
```
Will drop this into the draft.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite for POC-scope-call created by Maya at 2026-03-21 10:00.

Maya (AE): Thanks all — will collate and send. If they insist on full-scale embeddings+low-latency chat without extra commit, we'll offer a staged plan and emphasize measurable KPIs for go/no-go at week 2.
